targets.title: Illiquidity and Stock Returns: Cross-Section and Time-Series Effects.
targets.evidence_quote: In revisiting this analysis, we begin by considering the same sample period (1964 to 1996), method and data selection criteria employed by A02 to repli- cate the reported findings. Then, we repeat the same tests using out-of-sample (1997 to 2015) and full sample (1964 to 2015) periods to examine whether the original results and conclusions endure.
targets.outcome_quote: While the cross-sectional illiquidity remains positive and significant for all model speci- fications, it markedly decreases in magnitude. The time-series regression terms maintain the same sign but lose their monotonic properties and much of their significance.
targets.outcome_reasoning: New-period replication preserves the cross-sectional finding but fails the time-series significance and monotonicity comparisons. Authors explicitly describe this contrast. The same-period reconstruction supports the earlier findings, but is not an overall successful verdict over the new-period tests.
